module.name: BNK Prerequisites
module.description: Creates BNK namespaces, FAR image pull secrets, and downloads the BNK manifest to parse component versions. This is the first module in the BNK stack — everything else depends on it.

required.name: cne_pull_secret
required.description: Base64-encoded F5 FAR service account key JSON content

optional.name: cne_core_namespace
optional.description: Namespace for FLO operator and CNE core components (CWC, IPAM, RabbitMQ, Observer, OTEL)

optional.name: cne_instance_namespace
optional.description: Namespace for CNEInstance workloads (TMM, CNE controller, VLANs, NADs)

optional.name: bnk_manifest_version
optional.description: BNK manifest version to download from FAR

key_outputs.name: cne_core_namespace
key_outputs.description: CNE core namespace (FLO, CWC, IPAM, Observer)

key_outputs.name: cne_instance_namespace
key_outputs.description: CNE instance namespace (TMM, VLANs, NADs, controller)

key_outputs.name: far_secret_name
key_outputs.description: Name of the FAR image pull secret (always 'far-secret')

key_outputs.name: flo_version
key_outputs.description: FLO Helm chart version from manifest

key_outputs.name: prerequisites_ready
key_outputs.description: Gate output — true when all prerequisites are ready
